questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Sycophant
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Sycophant
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Fawner.

Key Points

  • The word "sycophant" means a person who acts obsequiously toward someone important in order to gain advantage. (चापलूस)
    • Example: He was surrounded by sycophants who were eager to flatter him and gain his favor.
  • "Fawner" refers to a person who shows exaggerated flattery or affection, typically in order to gain favor or advantage. (चापलूस)
    • Example: The fawner at the office never missed an opportunity to compliment the boss.
  • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'sycophant' is 'fawner'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Arrogant (अभिमानी): Having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.
    • Example: The arrogant manager refused to listen to his team's suggestions.
  • Uppity (घमंडी): Self-important; arrogant.
    • Example: She became very uppity after she got the promotion.
  • Independent (स्वतंत्र): Free from outside control; not depending on another's authority.
    • Example: She is an independent woman who makes her own decisions.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Inanimate
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Inanimate
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Lifeless.

Key Points

  • The word "Inanimate" means something that is not alive, especially not in the manner of animals and humans. It refers to objects that do not possess life. (निर्जीव)
    • Example: The rocks and stones are inanimate objects that you can find in nature.
  • "Lifeless" refers to something that lacks life or is without vitality. It is often used to describe something that is dead or lacks the qualities associated with living beings. (निर्जीव)
    • Example: The abandoned house had a lifeless appearance, with no signs of activity or habitation.
  • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of "Inanimate" is "Lifeless".

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Lifeless.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Cartoon (कार्टून): A simple drawing showing the features of its subjects in a humorously exaggerated way.
    • Example: The newspaper features a cartoon that makes fun of the current political situation.
  • Inhumane (अमानवीय): Lacking compassion and mercy; cruel and barbaric.
    • Example: The inhumane treatment of animals in the circus was condemned by animal rights activists.
  • Imitate (नकल करना): To take or follow as a model; to copy someone or something.
    • Example: Children often imitate their parents' behavior and mannerisms.

questions.question: Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence. The prisoners were living in appalling conditions.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The prisoners were living in appalling conditions.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: shocking.

Key Points

  • The word "appalling" means something that is horrifying or terrible; it describes conditions that are extremely bad or shocking. (भयानक)
    • Example: The news of the disaster was appalling and left everyone in shock.
  • "Shocking" refers to something that causes intense surprise, disgust, or horror; it is similar to appalling in that it describes extreme negative reactions. (चौंकाने वाला)
    • Example: The shocking revelation about the corruption scandal made headlines.
  • Hence, we can infer that the synonym of 'appalling' is 'shocking'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: shocking.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Daring (साहसी): Willing to take risks; bold.
    • Example: His daring rescue of the trapped hikers was widely praised.
  • Ingenious (अद्भुत): Very clever or inventive.
    • Example: She came up with an ingenious solution to the complex problem.
  • Risky (जोखिम भरा): Full of risk; dangerous.
    • Example: Investing in that startup was a risky decision.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Intractable
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Intractable
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 1 (Defiant).

Key Points

  • The word "Intractable" means something that is hard to deal with, manage, or control; stubborn or unmanageable. (दुराग्रही, जिद्दी)
    • Example: The intractable child refused to listen to his parents and threw a tantrum in the store.
  • "Defiant" refers to someone who resists authority or refuses to comply with rules, often in a bold or rebellious way. (अवज्ञाकारी, विद्रोही)
    • Example: The defiant student refused to follow the teacher's instructions and openly argued in class.
  • Therefore, we can infer that "Defiant" is the correct synonym for "Intractable".

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1 (Defiant).

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Proper (उचित): Something that is appropriate or suitable in the circumstances.
    • Example: She followed the proper procedure to submit her application on time.
  • Versatile (बहुमुखी): Someone or something that is adaptable and capable of performing many functions.
    • Example: He is a versatile actor who can play both comedic and dramatic roles effectively.
  • Compliant (आज्ञाकारी): Someone who is willing to follow rules or agree to requests.
    • Example: The compliant employee immediately adjusted her schedule to accommodate the manager’s request.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Idle
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Idle
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Unoccupied.

Key Points

  • The word "Idle" means something or someone that is not active, not in use, or without purpose. (निष्क्रिय, खाली)
    • Example: The factory has been idle for weeks due to the workers' strike.
  • "Unoccupied" refers to something that is not being used, filled, or inhabited at the moment. (खाली, अप्रयुक्त)
    • Example: The chair next to me is unoccupied; you can sit there.
  • Hence, we can conclude that the most appropriate synonym for 'Idle' is 'Unoccupied'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Unoccupied.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Unsafe (असुरक्षित): Something that is not safe or poses a risk.
    • Example: The old bridge is unsafe for vehicles and pedestrians.
  • Ungrateful (अकृतज्ञ): Someone who does not show or feel gratitude.
    • Example: He was ungrateful for the help he received during his tough times.
  • Uneasy (असहज): Feeling anxious, uncomfortable, or unsettled.
    • Example: She felt uneasy walking alone at night in the dark alley.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Hermetic
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Hermetic
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Esoteric.

Key Points

  • The word "Hermetic" refers to something that is tightly sealed, isolated, or difficult to understand. It can also mean something esoteric or obscure, understood only by a specific group. (संवेदनशील और गुप्त)
    • Example: The hermetic seal on the container ensured that no air or moisture could enter.
  • "Esoteric" refers to knowledge or information that is intended for or understood by only a small group of people with specialized knowledge or interest. (गुप्त, केवल कुछ लोगों के लिए समझने योग्य)
    • Example: The professor's lecture on quantum mechanics was so esoteric that only a few students could follow it.
  • Hence, "Hermetic" is synonymous with "Esoteric" because both imply something complex, obscure, or sealed off from general understanding.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Esoteric.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Intelligible (समझने योग्य): Something that can be understood easily.
    • Example: The teacher explained the concept in an intelligible way so that everyone could understand.
  • Obnoxious (अरुचिकर): Extremely unpleasant or offensive.
    • Example: His obnoxious behavior irritated everyone at the party.
  • Lucid (स्पष्ट): Clear and easy to understand.
    • Example: The author's lucid writing style made the complex subject accessible to readers.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Vivid
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Vivid
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Bright.

Key Points

  • The word "Vivid" means something that is strikingly bright, clear, or full of life and energy. It often refers to sharp and intense impressions. (ज्वलंत, स्पष्ट, जीवंत)
    • Example: The artist used vivid colors to bring the painting to life.
  • "Bright" refers to something that emits or reflects a lot of light; it can also mean something cheerful or lively. (चमकीला, उज्ज्वल)
    • Example: The room was filled with bright sunlight streaming through the windows.
  • Since "Bright" closely aligns with the meaning of "Vivid," it is the most appropriate synonym.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Bright.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Varied (विविध): Showing a variety or diversity.
    • Example: The varied landscape includes mountains, rivers, and forests.
  • Soothing (सुकून देने वाला): Having a calming or relaxing effect.
    • Example: The soothing music helped her fall asleep quickly.
  • Dull (मंद, फीका): Lacking brightness, sharpness, or liveliness.
    • Example: The sky looked dull and gray before the storm.

questions.solution: 'Radical' refers to those who hold extreme political or social views that are not shared by most people. Example: The radical views sparked debate. 'Fanatical', which means filled with excessive and single-minded zeal. Example: Her fanatical behavior worried her friends.

questions.question: Choose the word that means the same as the given word. Ulterior
questions.questionHtml:

Ulterior
questions.solution: The correct answer: Eventual. 'Ulterior' refers to something that is existing beyond what is obvious or admitted; intentionally hidden. Eg. He had an ulterior motive. 'Eventual' is the closest synonym among the given options, it means happening or existing at a later time. Eg. He was excited about his eventual promotion.

questions.question: Choose the word that means the same as the given word. Wage
questions.questionHtml:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Wage
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3' i.e. 'Emolument'.
 Key Points
  • The given word "Wage" refers to a fixed regular payment, typically paid on a daily or weekly basis, made by an employer to an employee, especially to a manual or unskilled worker.(वेतन).

questions.question: Choose the word that means the same as the given word. Confirm

Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Confirm

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Fetish
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Fetish
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "Desire".

Key Points

  •  A "fetish" typically refers to an excessive and irrational devotion or commitment to a particular thing.(किसी विशेष चीज़ के प्रति अत्यधिक और अतार्किक भक्ति या प्रतिबद्धता)
  • The word carries connotations of a deep-seated "desire" or obsession.
  • A "desire" is a strong feeling of wanting or wishing for something.(किसी चीज़ को चाहने या चाहने की प्रबल भावना) Given that a fetish is often driven by an intense, irrational wish, "desire" is a synonym that captures the longing aspect of "fetish."
  • From the above meaning it is clear that both words are synonyms to each other. 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".

Additional Information

  • "Awkward" usually means uncomfortable, embarrassing, or not at ease.(अजीब) Although a fetish can sometimes make social interaction awkward, this word doesn't directly relate to the meaning of "fetish" itself.
  • A "requirement" is something mandatory or needed.(आवश्यकता) While a fetish may feel crucial to the person who has it, the term "requirement" does not capture the obsessive or excessive nature of a fetish.
  • "Learning" refers to the acquisition of knowledge or skills through study, experience, or being taught.(सीखना) It doesn't connect with the meaning of "fetish," which is more about an intense inclination or obsession.

questions.solution: The word "Venial" means (used about a sin, fault or mistake) not very serious and able to be forgiven. Example: That was a venial sin. The word "pardonable" is a synonym of 'venial.' The word "Pardonable" means able to be forgiven; excusable. Example: These are probably pardonable blemishes.

questions.question: Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word. Assail
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Assail
questions.solution: "Assail" means to attack violently or criticize harshly. Example: The army was able to assail the enemy's stronghold and capture it. The word 'attack' means to try to hurt or defeat somebody/something by using force. Example: The child was attacked by a dog. "Attack" is the word that means the same as the given word "assail."

questions.question: Choose the word that means the same as the given word. Habitant
questions.questionHtml:

Habitant
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option no.(1) i.e. 'Denizen'.Key Points

  • The word 'Habitant' means a person who inhabits a particular place.
    • Example: Last year there were 130 murders for every 100,000 habitants in the city.
  • The word 'Denizen' means a person, animal, or plant that lives or is found in a particular place.

questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution: Contrite means feeling or expressing remorse or penitence. Synonyms of contrite include remorseful, regretful, apologetic, and penitent. Remorseful means a feeling of deep regret, guilt, or sorrow for one's actions or decisions.
